newsitem.title: USA: Toro $175 mln debt offering priced.
newsitem.headline: Toro $175 mln debt offering priced.

text.p: Toro Co said Wednesday a $175 million debt offering was priced.

The offering consists of $75 million of 7.125 percent coupon 10-year notes and $100 million of 7.80 percent 30-year debentures. Toro said it intends to use the net proceeds to repay short-term indebtedness, the majority of which was used to fund the acquisition of James Hardie Irrigation in December 1996.
The balance of the net proceeds will be used to redeem the company's $50 million principal amount of outstanding 11 percent Sinking Fund Debentures on August 1, 1997.
Underwriters for the offering are Goldman, Sachs & Co, BancAmerica Securities Inc, and NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc.
